calls.statement:
WITH q1_fy2026_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    p.subcategory,
    SUM(s.quantity) as total_quantity_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line s
  JOIN dim_product p ON s.product_key = p.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
  GROUP BY p.subcategory
),
q1_fy2026_returns AS (
  SELECT 
    p.subcategory,
    SUM(r.quantity_returned) as total_quantity_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON r.return_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
  GROUP BY p.subcategory
)
SELECT 
  s.subcategory,
  s.total_quantity_sold,
  COALESCE(r.total_quantity_returned, 0) as total_quantity_returned,
  ROUND(COALESCE(r.total_quantity_returned, 0) * 100.0 / s.total_quantity_sold, 2) as return_rate_pct
FROM q1_fy2026_sales s
LEFT JOIN q1_fy2026_returns r ON s.subcategory = r.subcategory
ORDER BY s.subcategory
